verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer docs mention webhooks as part of its Batch APIs ("webhooks included"). That indicates first-party outbound callbacks, but nothing in the pack documents how to register them, which events can be subscribed to, or what the payloads look like. The Slack, Zapier, n8n and Make integrations are not webhooks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription endpoint, event catalog, payload/signature details, coverage beyond batch jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
